description: Revert the reviewed current release for its exact lane; reverting a release that is rolling out cancels the rollout. Requires expected state and an idempotency key and reports pending manifest synchronization truthfully.

appId.description: OtaKit app ID. Optional on a local connection whose project configures one; required otherwise.

expectedRolloutPercent.description: When cancelling a rollout: the rollout percentage that was reviewed. The revert is refused if the rollout changed or completed meanwhile.

forceImmediate.description: Make devices apply and reload on their next check

idempotencyKey.description: Stable key reused only when retrying this exact mutation

name: revert_release
title: Revert an OtaKit release
